title: B1 Preliminary for Schools – Victory sample test 1 – Writing

groups.instructions: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

questions.stimulusHtml:
Read this email from your English-speaking friend Alex and the notes you have made.

From: Alex
Subject: Saturday

Hi!

I'm so pleased you can come to the town festival with me on Saturday. [Note: Me too!]

Shall we go in the morning or the afternoon? [Note: Say which and why]

There's a cooking show, a music stage and a football match. Which would you like to see? [Note: Tell Alex]

What should I bring? [Note: Suggest…]

See you soon,
Alex

Write your email to Alex using all the notes.

groups.instructions: Choose one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

questions.stimulusHtml:
You see this notice on an English-language website for teenagers.

Articles wanted!

MY FAVOURITE PLACE

Where is your favourite place? What do you do there?
Why do you like it so much?

The best articles will appear on our website next month!

Write your article.

Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.

Your story must begin with this sentence:

When Sam opened the old box, he couldn't believe his eyes.

Write your story.
